placement: Tooling / Conformance. conformance/store/ holds the language-neutral store vector set (store.vectors.json and its README): sequences of requests across named tabs with expected results and facts, and named fault injections a runner either performs or reports as unsupported. One plain-JavaScript runner (test/browser/packs/store-conformance/runner.js) executes them under node over an in-memory IndexedDB with injected faults (test/store-conformance.test.ts) and in Chromium (the store-conformance page). A store-tabs page proves the multi-tab scenarios with real second tabs: concurrent compare-and-put, readers that never see half a batch, and a tab closed mid-transaction. No pack behaviour changes.
